answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the sable of a task receipt, and the violet is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The ripple of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, published publicly on failure, rewards vest against future work. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
